# tcpshield_bedrock_tunnel_locations (Data Source)

Lists the locations a Bedrock tunnel of the network can be placed in (e.g. `FRA`, `IAD`, `ANY`).

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "tcpshield_bedrock_tunnel_locations" "all" {
  network_id = data.tcpshield_network.main.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `network_id` (Number) Network to list locations for.

### Read-Only

- `locations` (List of String) Location codes.
